description.narrative:
The objectives of the intervention have been updated based on the New Strategic Note for UN Women 2021-2024 approved in October 2021. The main objective is "to contribute to the efforts carried out by Colombia to face the challenges and opportunities identified, mainly gender inequalities, to strengthen the empowerment of women and girls, their participation in the consolidation and stabilization in the territories and to guarantee their right to have a life free of violence".
The new structure of the Strategic Note differs from the previous one, based on the government's request to align it to the UN Cooperation Framework (UNSSCDF, but there are no substantial changes. All previous components and working lines are included in the following three areas:
1) Stabilization: Peace with Legality; 2) Migration as a development factor; and 3) Technical assistance for the acceleration of catalyst Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
Sweden's support is aligned with Areas 1 and 3 where peace issues and political and economic empowerment activities are included.

The overall objective of this unearmarked support to UN Women in Colombia is to contribute to strengthen the political and economic empowerment of women and their right to a life free from violence, both in the context of the conflict as well as beyond it, in a way that supports the construction of stable and sustainable peace. To achieve this, UN Women focuses on reaching the following results:
1) Increasing women’s leadership and participation in decision-making at all levels. 2) Economically empowering women, particularly the poorest and most excluded. 3) Guaranteeing a life free of violence for women and girls. 4) Shaping peace and security, and humanitarian action through female leadership and participation.
The support is a continuation of two previous phases with ID-numbers: 61000962 and 52060066.

UN Women:s kontor i Colombia har överlämnat ett förslag till Sveriges Ambassad i Bogotá om finansiering på 49 MSEK för att stödja implementeringen av det Landspecifika Strategiska Dokumentet i Colombia (Strategic Note Colombia) under perioden den 1 juni 2018 – 31 december 2021.
Det övergripande syftet med insatsen är att stärka den politiska och ekonomiska egenmakten av kvinnor och deras rätt till ett liv fritt från våld, både i kontexten av konflikt likväl som bortom detta, på ett sätt som stödjer byggandet av en varaktig och hållbar fred. I avsikt att uppnå detta, kommer UN Women under denna period att fokusera på följande områden: 1) Kvinnor leder och medverkar i beslutstagande på alla nivåer; 2) Kvinnor, särskilt de fattigaste och mest exkluderade, åstadkommer ekonomisk egenmakt genom och med fördel av utveckling; 3) Kvinnor och flickor lever ett liv fritt från våld; 4) Fred och säkerhet, och humanitära aktioner är formade av kvinnligt ledarskap och deltagande.

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

title.narrative: Decision on support to UN Women Colombia 2018-2021

description.narrative:
Some examples of the results achieved are: - Gender mainstreaming and strengthening efforts of the Systems for Truth, Justice, Reparation and Non-Repetition. In relation to the Special Jurisdiction for Peace (JEP), UN Women promoted the implementation of the international standards to investigate conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV) and gender-based violence (GBV) in 5 of the JEPs macro-cases. UN Women also supported the aggrupation and concentration phase of macro-case No. 11 on Sexual Violence, Reproductive Violence and other crimes based on Gender, Sex, and Sexual Identity or Orientation.
- In a partnership among the Truth Commission (CEV), UN Women and Sweden, the documentary When the Waters Flow as One was finalized and disseminated. The documentary showcases Colombian women's contribution to peacebuilding for over 20 years and serves as a contribution to historical memory and as a tool to position women's role in peacebuilding in the public agenda. Since its release (March 8th, 2023), the documentary has had more than 150 showings in more than 17 countries, reaching more than 15,000 in-person viewers.
- In 2023, the Government of Colombia began its participatory elaboration of the country's first Resolution 1325 National Action Plan (NAP), and Sweden's alliance with UN Women directly supported the process. First, support was provided to establish the Impulse Committee for the 1325 NAP. Second, support was provided to implement the agreed upon roadmap: 1,500 women from different parts of the country participated in 6 macro-regional forums, 7 territorial meetings, and 7 sectorial consultations. Third, a multidisciplinary team was established to support the National Government in the formulation of the NAP 1325. The National Government has announced that its 1325 NAP will be launched in 2024.
- Through the strategy More Women, More Democracy a certified 100-hour training program was implemented with the ESAP and CPEM to train women on Colombia's political system, political planning and strategies, electoral management, and mainstreaming of the women's rights perspective. The training program En Paridad benefitted over 1,000 women as they enhanced the political and leadership skills for the local elections.
- UN Women also organized the National Forum of Elected Women and three Local Forum of Elected Women in the departments of Cauca, Nariño, and Chocó. In these Forums, women exchanged experiences and strengthened networks for the advancement of the gender equality and women's rights agenda, reaching 120 participating women at a national level and 189 participating women in the local level (100 women in Nariño, 60 women in Cauca, and 29 women in Chocó).
